gary.text: Bought a 200-watt marine speaker and two strings of LED rope light for the cart.
Donna asked if I'd ever played pickleball. I said no and changed the subject.
Read the parade flyer at the Town Square: sign-ups close at the end of the month.

I said to Hal: “Morning, Hal. Sorry about the Buffett, just testing the speaker and it's down now. I know the lights and sound need Architectural Review sign-off before the parade, so I'm wiring it in the garage first and filing the paperwork after.”

Donna said to Gary: “Gary, that speaker has great timing, and so do you. Come hit a few balls with me at the rec center this morning. I've got a spare paddle, it's thirty minutes, and coffee's on me.”

Rosa said to Hal: “Morning, Hal. Thanks for the recycling tip, you were right. I'm hosting a welcome dinner at my place and I'd like you, Gary, and Donna all at the table. Come hungry, and leave the cart and flamingo opinions at the door.”
I said to Donna: “Alright, Donna, you win. Thirty minutes and I'm holding you to the coffee, but I'm warning you, I'll be terrible at it.”

Rosa said to Gary: “Gary, before you two run off: I'm hosting a welcome dinner at my place, and you, Donna, and Hal are all invited. It's the least I can do after the disposal, and I'm not taking no for an answer.”

I said to Rosa: “Rosa, you've twisted my arm, I'll be there. I'll bring a bottle of something and leave the cart talk in the garage. Now I've got to go get embarrassed at pickleball, Donna's waiting on me.”
Rosa said to Gary: “Gary, since you're headed to the courts with Donna: dinner's tonight at six, my place. Tell her for me, and go easy on the paddle, I need you in one piece to eat.”

gary: Since Linda passed, the garage is where I feel most like myself.
Hal doesn't like me much, but nobody on this street knows wiring like I do.
donna: Partners make or break your ladder ranking, and mine keep moving to Ocala.
Gary has quick hands and nothing to do on weekends. He just doesn't know he wants to play yet.
hal: Rules exist so neighbors don't have to argue. Somebody has to keep them.
The street was quieter before the new speaker arrived.
rosa: I moved here to slow down, and so far I've worked four shifts and met nobody.
These three neighbors clearly have history I don't understand yet.

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
